name: popspell
description: PopSpell (popspell.com): the scripts that check the site. The site itself needs no install: GitHub Pages serves these files as they are.

scripts.rules: cd firebase && npm install --no-audit --no-fund && npx --yes firebase-tools@13.35.1 emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-popspell "node rules.test.mjs"
